cohort: Pregnancies that ended in maternal death at Chris Hani Baragwanath Academic Hospital, Johannesburg, South Africa, over a 5-year period
finding: Women who experience maternal death have babies with very poor perinatal outcomes, with a very high stillbirth rate, early neonatal death rate, and perinatal mortality rate.
mod_finding: Of the 51 stillbirths, 11 (21.6%) were delivered by perimortem caesarean section.
